question: Which Indian personality headed the expert committee on digital competition law in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manoj Govil**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Manoj Govil**, the Secretary of the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, was appointed as the head of the expert committee on **Digital Competition Law** in India in **2025**. This committee was constituted to study antitrust issues in the digital economy.
 
• The expert committee was tasked with examining the need for a specialized **Digital Competition Act** to address competition concerns arising in the rapidly evolving digital markets.
 
• The committee was formed to evaluate practices like **anti-competitive agreements, abuse of dominant positions, mergers, and acquisitions** in digital markets to ensure fair competition and innovation.
 
• This initiative aligns with India’s approach to maintaining transparency and fairness within its **digital economy**, which is experiencing exponential growth.
 
• Manoj Govil's extensive expertise in corporate governance and regulatory frameworks made him a suitable choice to lead the committee and develop recommendations to tackle **digital competition challenges**.
